name: Cheng Haorang
source:
Although Haorang is friendly and outgoing, he does not have many friends because he spends most of his time obsessing about an old mansion that he passes by on the way to school each day, and the strange dreams that he has at night.
Haorang is generous and free-spirited, and he does not care about what other people think of him.
[From [url=https://marie-marie.itch.io/one-last-goodbye]itch.io[/url]]
